info.title: Platform API
info.description: Job Tracker, Health Monitor, and Auth. See docs/api.md for the human-authored source of truth (ADR-011).

bearerAuth.description: Optional on most endpoints: absent -> guest, scoped to demo data; present and valid -> admin, scoped to real data. A present-but-invalid token always 401s (never silently downgraded to guest). Required in practice for GET /auth/me.

details.description: Present for 400s: Zod's flattened field-error map (object-wide issues under `_errors`). Omitted for 401/404/500.

CreateJobApplicationRequest.description: status defaults to SAVED, currency defaults to USD when omitted.

UpdateJobApplicationRequest.description: Partial update — all fields optional, but at least one is required.

CreateGlucoseRequest.description: Exactly one of fastingValue/afterMealValue must be provided.

UpdateGlucoseRequest.description: Partial update, or ignore/restore a record via `ignored`+`reason`.

CreateBloodPressureRequest.description: systolic must be greater than diastolic.

UpdateBloodPressureRequest.description: Partial update, or ignore/restore a record via `ignored`+`reason`.

UpdateWeightRequest.description: Partial update, or ignore/restore a record via `ignored`+`reason`.

CreateSymptomRequest.description: Create a symptom entry. intensity is 1-10.

UpdateSymptomRequest.description: Partial update, or ignore/restore a record via `ignored`+`reason`.
